questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in the center of the frame (approx 00:06-00:10), exactly three pens are visible.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the black caps at the bottom and barrels pointing up.
All three pens appear to be identical in color, with black caps and dark/translucent barrels.
All pens appear complete with caps on; no bare tips or significant length differences are visible.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right side without stopping or reversing.
